notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running wifi-manager. CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match wifi/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline; PID 378, comm python3). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on read-only GETs (--repeats 40). NO mutating routes exercised: POST /connect, GET /disconnect, POST /remove, POST /hotspot, POST /hotspot_credentials, POST /smart_hotspot change wireless association / hotspot and could disrupt reachability; those journey outcomes remain Unknown. GET /scan not probed for SLO (triggers a live wlan scan; variable, semi-mutating). Raw evidence: /tmp/wifi_sample.json, /tmp/wifi_slo.json.

route_inventory.note: Read-only status GETs probed; mutating routes deliberately not exercised (wireless reachability hazard).

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running wifi-manager (idle station mode, hotspot off).

GET /status.body_predicate: current wlan0 association status from wpa_supplicant

slo_running_baseline.note: GET /status is heaviest (~30 ms) since it queries the wpa_supplicant control socket; the settings-backed GETs are fast (6-8 ms).

running_baseline.method: /proc stat deltas, top-style (100 == 1 core), PID 378 python3 wifi/main.py
running_baseline.note: Near-idle in station mode; RSS flat at ~46 MB, CPU mostly 0 with small periodic polling.

navigator.notes: wifi manages wlan0/uap0 regardless of flight controller; platform-independent on this Pi4/Navigator host. Handler is the wpa_supplicant path (Bullseye) on this image.

state_machine: none (service_definition states: Unknown; a wpa_supplicant event loop and hotspot watchdog reconcile periodically, not a discrete state machine)
settings_mutations: Not exercised. Hotspot/smart-hotspot routes persist to /root/.config/wifi-manager/settings-1.json (SettingsV1); wifi credentials persist via wpa_supplicant SAVE_CONFIG. Not mutated during this read-only capture.
